$comment: Single source of truth for rendered marketing assets.
'scenes' drives staleness triage: an entry tagged ['room'] is invalidated by any
commit touching InteriorScene, ['corridor'] by CorridorScene. Entries tagged only
['exterior'] or ['hall'] survived the 2026-09-05 overhauls and need no re-render.
'renderer' names the script that produces it. 'still' entries are handled by
scripts/marketing/render.mjs directly; 'video' entries delegate to the recorders
in scripts/week1 (they drive multi-step flows that are not worth re-implementing).
Render everything a scene invalidated:  node scripts/marketing/render.mjs --scenes room,corridor

notes.$note_not_product_renders: hero-ob.mp4, hero-v2.mp4 and hero-bg.mp4 were REMOVED from this manifest on 2026-09-05. Inspecting their frames showed they are cinematic stock/AI footage (a woman walking a sunlit corridor; a Tuscan landscape through an arch; a cypress avenue to a villa) — they contain no product geometry, so a 3D overhaul cannot make them stale. They were originally ranked top priority purely on file date and exposure, which was wrong. Leave them alone; replacing them with 3D renders would be a creative decision, not a staleness fix.
